subject.title: fix: workflow sanity audit passes on main

question: Should the fallback GitHub App be authorized for read-only repository contents so it can remain a functional recovery token for the labeler workflow?
rationale: This repository diff can request the permission, but only the App installation owner can confirm that the fallback credential should receive that boundary and demonstrate the intended recovery behavior.

options.title: Authorize and prove the fallback path
options.body: Confirm the fallback App has only the needed read-only contents permission and provide a redacted run showing fallback minting, configuration read, and label application.

options.title: Keep fallback least-privilege without contents access
options.body: Do not merge this request until the workflow is redesigned so the fallback path does not need to read repository configuration.

recommendation.title: Authorize and prove the fallback path
recommendation.body: Confirm the fallback App has only the needed read-only contents permission and provide a redacted run showing fallback minting, configuration read, and label application.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the current proof updates, though confirmation must come from the GitHub App installation owner.
